title: Dreamers & Thinkers
address: 939 E Hillsdale Blvd, Foster City, CA 94404
locationNote: Confirm the lesson room and drop-off location with your school.

programs.title: Circle Piano Group Class
programs.description: Learn piano through small-group instruction, rhythm games and ensemble playing.
programs.details:
A small-group piano program for ages 4+, with one teacher and up to six students. Groups are arranged according to each child’s level, readiness and individual needs.
Children learn at individual piano stations through stories, movement, musical games, guided playing and ensemble activities.
Learning continues at home with worksheets that reinforce note patterns, musical letter names and keyboard skills. Your school’s staff will confirm placement and arrangements.
programs.schedule: Follow your school schedule. Our staff will follow up with you.

programs.title: Private Instruments Class
programs.description: Individual music instruction shaped around each student’s interests and experience.
programs.details:
One-to-one instrument instruction adapted to the student’s age, experience and learning goals. Beginners and students with prior experience can share their background when registering.
Lessons connect technique, musical understanding and performance preparation. Follow the teacher’s practice recommendations and use a notebook or digital practice journal for assignments, feedback and questions.
Choose your instrument and describe your experience in the registration form. Our staff will follow up with you about your teacher, lesson length and arrangements at your school.
programs.schedule: Follow your school schedule. Our staff will follow up with you.
